name: 6801-call-not-now
about: needs-call calls six game functions that read scene objects with no test (MarioAccess::validateSensor, MR::incPlayerLife, MR::incCoin, MR::getPlayerPos, MR::isPlayerDead, MR::getCamPos) at boot frame 1, with no scene: none is made, each gives its empty value (null, false, a zero vector), the mod's log says Call.NotNow, and the game goes on; in play the same calls are made (the player's position is there). Before M2 the first call ended the game

expect.log: needs-call: MarioAccess::validateSensor void\(\) was not called: it needs MarioActor, which the game does not have now\.
needs-call: MR::getCamPos const Vec3f\(\) was not called: it needs CameraContext, which the game does not have now\.
